labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: Issue asks for new behaviour (orange text colour) in Rich; feature requests are labelled enhancement.

items.body:
Feature requests need to be approved in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue is opened, so please start there if you want this changed in Rich.

Rich can already print orange text without any change to the library. Pass a named colour as a style, for example `console.print("Hello", style="orange1")`, or use markup such as `[orange1]Hello[/orange1]`. The named colours are defined in [rich/color.py](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/color.py), and styles are described in [docs/source/style.rst](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/style.rst).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
